description: This file defines the ObjectLambdaAccessPointArn class within the AWS SDK for PHP, representing a specific type of Amazon S3 Resource ARN with methods to parse and validate such ARNs.

classes.name: ObjectLambdaAccessPointArn
classes.description: Represents an S3 Object Lambda Access Point ARN, with methods for parsing and validation of ARN components.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string into an associative array of components representing an ObjectLambdaAccessPointArn.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the parsed ARN data, specifically the region and account ID for Object Lambda ARNs.
